title: SSFNet: Lightweight Multispectral UAV Vision Architecture for Real-Time Weed Detection and Precision Targeted Spraying
unit_of_analysis: Multispectral deep learning segmentation architectures and their dual-branch spectral-visible fusion designs evaluated under empirical benchmark quantification
epistemological_rationale: Design Science paradigm with empirical benchmark quantification across open agricultural datasets, requiring reported numeric segmentation accuracy and edge-side efficiency metrics on reproducible benchmarks.

research_questions.text: Does a dual-branch spatial-spectral cross-attention architecture (SSFNet) outperform unimodal RGB and channel-stacked early-fusion multi-band baselines in weed-vs-crop segmentation accuracy (mIoU, weed IoU, weed F1) on open agricultural UAV datasets?

Can the multispectral fusion architecture sustain the real-time targeted-spraying threshold (>=30 FPS on NVIDIA Jetson-class edge) while keeping parameter count under 0.6M, and what is the measured latency (ms), FLOPs, and throughput trade-off against accuracy?

How robust is the multispectral weed segmentation model to domain shifts from lighting variation, crop phenological stage, and sensor band calibration when evaluated across multiple agricultural benchmark datasets?

inclusion_criteria.criterion: Reports empirical segmentation, detection, or classification results (numeric mIoU, F1, Precision/Recall, IoU, mAP) specifically for weed-vs-crop discrimination in agricultural imagery.

Uses multispectral, hyperspectral, or multi-band aerial imagery (including at least one of NIR, RedEdge, NDVI, NDRE, or vegetation-index fusion) OR explicitly evaluates spectral band fusion against a visible/RGB baseline.

Deployment or evaluation context is a UAV / UAS platform, aerial platform, or edge/embedded agricultural hardware; or the study reports edge-side efficiency metrics (latency ms, FPS, GFLOPs, parameter count).

Evaluates on an open, public, or specifically identifiable agricultural benchmark dataset (e.g., WeedMap, Agriculture-Vision, SugarBeet2016, DeepWeeds) or a described reproducible experimental dataset with named crop/weed classes.

exclusion_criteria.criterion: No weed detection/segmentation outcome: studies on pest or disease classification, grain/crop quality grading, or general vegetation mapping without weed-crop discrimination.
Includes only satellite-scale or fixed-wing macro remote sensing without usable UAV-resolution (aerial close-range) weed imagery or edge/embedded context.
Strictly RGB-only vision with no spectral/band-fusion component and no weed-specific segmentation or detection architecture.
Non-empirical meta-publications: surveys, review letters, position papers, or editorials without algorithmic implementation and benchmark numbers.
Non-English text, unverified abstract-only records, or records lacking retrievable full text for code/data availability verification.

matrix_dimensions.name: Model Architecture & Fusion Strategy
matrix_dimensions.description: Backbone and detection/segmentation head; fusion mechanism is early (channel stack), late, or dual-branch cross-attention. Capture the exact network name and fusion design.

matrix_dimensions.name: Benchmark Dataset
matrix_dimensions.description: Exact name of the open agricultural dataset used (e.g., WeedMap, Agriculture-Vision, SugarBeet2016, DeepWeeds) and the number of images/classes.

matrix_dimensions.name: Sensor Bands & Input Modality
matrix_dimensions.description: Bands and channels fused as input (e.g., RGB, NIR, RedEdge, NDVI, NDRE, Thermal). State the input channel count and acquisition platform (UAV/UAS).

matrix_dimensions.name: Segmentation Accuracy Metrics
matrix_dimensions.description: Reported numeric accuracy: mIoU (%), weed IoU (%), weed F1 (%), mAP@50. Capture numbers as-is with units and note the class each refers to.

matrix_dimensions.name: Computational Efficiency & Edge Profiling
matrix_dimensions.description: Reported latency (ms), throughput (FPS), GFLOPs, parameter count (M), and the target edge hardware (e.g., NVIDIA Jetson Orin). Capture numeric values with units.

matrix_dimensions.name: Accuracy Gain vs RGB Baseline
matrix_dimensions.description: Reported numeric improvement of the multispectral/spectral method over the RGB-only baseline in mIoU or F1 (e.g., +X.X points). Capture signed numeric value.

matrix_dimensions.name: Crop, Growth Stage & Weed Species
matrix_dimensions.description: Target crop type (e.g., sugar beet, maize), crop phenological stage, and weed species evaluated. Capture as free text.

matrix_dimensions.name: Cross-Dataset / Domain Shift Robustness
matrix_dimensions.description: Reported generalization across datasets, lighting conditions, growth stages, or sensor calibrations (e.g., cross-dataset mIoU, robustness experiments).
